title: Baobab Tenant–Organisation and Tenant–LegalEntity Mapping Contracts (ADR-BCP-018)
description:
Target path: baobab-platform/shared/contracts/organisation/v1/mapping.schema.json

Explicit mappings that replace the implicit singular Tenant.LegalEntityID over time.

Compatibility rule (ADR-BCP-018):
  The current singular Tenant.LegalEntityID field is treated as a compatibility
  projection of the default TenantLegalEntityMapping (is_default = true) until
  all consumers migrate. It MUST NOT be removed or given a new meaning.

  Existing BUYER_ORGANISATION and SUPPLIER_ORGANISATION CanonicalEntity records
  migrate forward without destructive rewriting.

IAM Organisation claims map only through ExternalReference / canonical mappings;
never as direct authorization input.

Control Plane is the runtime authority for these mappings.

TenantOrganisationMapping.description: Explicit association of a Tenant with one or more Organisations. A tenant may serve multiple organisations; an organisation may be represented in multiple tenants only when approved isolation requires it.

is_default.description: When true, this mapping is the conventional primary organisation for the tenant. At most one default per tenant is expected.

TenantLegalEntityMapping.description: Explicit association of a Tenant with one or more LegalEntityProfiles. The row with is_default = true is the compatibility projection of Tenant.LegalEntityID.

is_default.description: When true, this mapping is the value exposed as Tenant.LegalEntityID for v1 compatibility. Exactly one default mapping SHOULD exist for every active tenant.
